question:
The given sentence has an error. Select the option that contains the error in the given sentence.

We have to be cautius regarding the impact of global warming.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the misspelling of the word "**cautius**."
 
• The correct spelling should be "**cautious**."
 
• Proper spelling ensures the sentence is grammatically **correct and clear.**
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 4** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"We have to be **cautious** regarding the impact of global warming."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **We have to** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **of global warming** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **regarding the impact** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
